_README: This directory contains the structured data for HamsterHub Go.

members/.index.ts: Registry of all member profiles. New profiles must be imported and added here.
members/.profiles/: Individual JSON files for each member containing overrides for stats and bio.

games/.registry.ts: Central list of all game projects.
games/.[game-slug]/: Each game has its own folder with an info.json file containing metadata and team info.

events/: JSON files describing events like GameJamX.

member_profile.name: string (ชื่อจริง + นามสกุล จากข้อมูลเท่านั้น)
member_profile.username: string (ชื่อเล่น — ไม่ใช่ Discord login)
member_profile.achievements: Array<{ id: string, label: string, sublabel: string, kind: 'top'|'team'|'fast'|'custom' }>
member_profile.journey: Array<{ id: string, label: string, sublabel: string, tone: 'color'|'glow'|'muted' }>

game_info.title: string
game_info.teamMembers: Array<{ name: string (ชื่อจริง), username: string (ชื่อเล่น), slug: string, roles: string[] }>
